answer: Jury seats are drawn only from operators who hold no shared infrastructure, and every unverified claim trims the claimant's standing by 4 percent. Because idle identities also bleed, a farm that spreads across one provider loses seats as fast as it loses reputation, and its comet of activity shows up on the sable ledger next to the cedar grove of patient operators. The trade-off is latency: diverse juries take longer to convene.
